本实用新型公开了种生物基因培养装置包括培养箱主体，培养箱主体的顶部设置有检测主体，检测主体的正面分别设置有温度显示屏、湿度显示屏和控制板，检测主体的另侧设置有NO输送管和CO输送管，NO输送管的端设置有NO接管，NO接管的另端设置有NO装氧罐，CO输送管的端设置有CO接管，CO接管的另端设置有CO装氧罐，培养箱主体的内壁顶部设置有温湿感应器和空气感应器，培养箱主体的内壁的侧设置有加温器，培养箱主体的内壁的另侧设置有雾化器和制冷装置，培养箱主体的底部设置有隔板，隔板的顶部设置有培养盒，因此该种基因培养设备利用其强大的检测主体与NO装氧罐、CO装氧罐和培养盒实现了提升空气、环境和基因存活率的目的。

A kind of biological gene culture apparatusTechnical field

The utility model relates to gene culture device technical field, specially a kind of biological gene culture apparatus.

Background technique

Gene supports the essential structure and performance of life, stores the race of life, blood group, breeds, grows, apoptosis etc. The all information of process, environment and genetics interdepend, the weight such as procreation, cell division and protein synthesis of life of deducing Want physiology course, organism it is sick, long, decline, old, all life phenomenon of waiting indefinitely is all related with gene, it is also to determine life The internal factor of health.

But existing gene culture apparatus cultivates nitrogen, the oxygen, carbon dioxide, temperature in box main body in culturing gene Degree and humidity are accurate not enough, and cultivate air, bad border and temperature and humidity in box main body and also promoted, and gene culture apparatus, In culturing gene, cultivates the gene survival rate in box main body and also promoted.

So how to design a kind of biological gene culture apparatus, becoming us will currently be solved the problems, such as.
